correctness.rationale: The exact rational identity \(y_*^2=q^3\cdot1116-3888\) was independently rechecked. At a degree-one good prime over 17 with \(\theta\mapsto12\), the point reduces to \((2,8)\) of exact order 9; at a degree-one good prime over 23 with \(\theta\mapsto13\), it reduces to \((17,17)\) of exact order 4. The curve and cubic discriminants and the denominators are units at those primes. If \(P\) were torsion of order \(N\), good-reduction injectivity on prime-to-residue-characteristic torsion would force simultaneously \(N=9\cdot17^a\) and \(N=4\cdot23^b\), impossible. The order-three automorphism \(\rho(x,y)=(\zeta_3^2x,y)\) satisfies \(1+\rho+\rho^2=0\). Since a nonzero Eisenstein endomorphism has finite kernel, the map \(\mathbb Z[\zeta_3]\to E\), \(a\mapsto aP\), is injective for non-torsion \(P\), proving the module and relation statements.

value.rationale: These are the distinguished singular-fiber values of a newly explicit canonical Albanese fibration. Determining that their symmetry orbit is non-torsion, and identifying the exact Eisenstein-module relation, gives a natural arithmetic invariant complementary to the geometric and monodromy descriptions of the fibration.

final_claim: For Szabó's three nodal critical values on \(E:y^2=x^3-3888\), the real value \(P=(q\theta,y_*)\), \(\theta^3=1116\), is of infinite order; therefore \(P,\rho P,\rho^2P\) form a non-torsion order-three orbit whose generated subgroup is a free rank-one \(\mathbb Z[\zeta_3]\)-module, with the only integral relation \(P+\rho P+\rho^2P=O\).
limitations: The theorem concerns the three nodal critical values in Szabó's explicit Albanese fibration, not the full Mordell--Weil group of \(E\) over the splitting field.
The free-module statement is for the subgroup generated by this orbit.
